flagged.evidence: The Definition allows “finite-dimensional spaces H0,...,HL” without requiring them to be nonzero. But def-qc-diamond-norm defines the norm only for “nonzero finite-dimensional complex Hilbert spaces.” The cited def-qc-quantum-channel permits finite-dimensional H and K without excluding zero; for example, the unique map from L(0) to L(C) is completely positive and trace-preserving vacuously. This is an allowed contract whose local and final d_diamond quantities are outside the norm definition's domain. Require every Hj to be nonzero.
